farmLocation.title: Farm location

home.askTitle: What would you like to ask?
home.tapMic: Tap the farmer and ask your question
home.welcomeSpeech: Namaste, welcome to Annadata 360. How can I help you today?

voice.title: Ask Annadata AI
voice.sampleBody: Tell us the crop age, symptoms and location. Different causes need different treatments. Do not apply chemicals until the cause is confirmed.
voice.listenText: Tell us the crop age, symptoms and location. Avoid applying chemicals until the problem is identified.
voice.micUnavailable: Voice input needs the full app build. Type your question instead.
voice.signInNeeded: Verify your phone number to ask the AI.
voice.micDenied: Microphone permission is off. Allow it in Settings to speak your question.
voice.noSpeech: Didn’t hear a question. Tap the mic and speak a little louder, close to the phone.
voice.languageNotSupported: This phone doesn't support voice input in this language. Type your question instead.
voice.speakHint: Speak in Telugu or English. Tap him again when you finish.
voice.speakingTapToStop: Speaking… tap the farmer to stop
voice.tooShort: Hold on — that was too short. Tap the mic and say your full question.
voice.tryAgainMic: Voice is switching to your phone’s speech typing. Tap the mic again.
voice.tapAgainToSend: Tap the farmer again to send

diagnosis.title: Crop Diagnosis
diagnosis.photoPrompt: Take a clear, close photo of the sick part of the plant
diagnosis.cameraDenied: Camera permission is needed to take a photo. Allow it in your phone settings.
diagnosis.photoTip: Good light, one leaf or stem filling the photo.
diagnosis.checkingHint: This can take up to 40 seconds.
diagnosis.signInNeeded: Verify your phone number to check your crop with a photo.
diagnosis.consultExpert: Show this to your Agriculture Extension Officer or KVK before spending on treatment.
diagnosis.chemicalSafety: For chemical sprays: wear gloves and a mask, follow the label dose, and do not spray before rain.
diagnosis.disclaimer: AI guidance, not a certified diagnosis. Confirm with an agriculture officer before costly treatment.

cropCheck.other: This looks like {{seen}}, not your {{crop}} crop.
cropCheck.unclear: Could not tell if this is your {{crop}} crop.
cropCheck.notPlant: This photo does not show a plant.

weather.title: Farm Weather
weather.locationNeeded: Set your farm location in Profile to see your weather forecast.

irrigation.title: Irrigation Assistant
irrigation.soilQuestion: How does the soil feel near the roots?
irrigation.signInForRain: Verify your phone to include the rain forecast in this advice.

why.wet: The soil is already waterlogged. Open the drains so roots get air.
why.rainComing: About {{mm}} mm of rain is expected in the next 2 days.
why.harvest: Near harvest the crop needs little water. Water only if plants are wilting.
why.harvestPaddy: Drain the field 10–15 days before harvest so the grain ripens evenly.
why.fingerTest: Push a finger 5 cm into the soil near the roots. If it is dry and crumbly, water. If it sticks to your finger, wait.
why.flowering: Flowering is the stage where water shortage cuts yield the most. Do not let the soil dry out.
why.hot: It will be hot today (about {{temp}}°C), so the soil dries fast.
why.dryPaddy: Paddy needs 2–5 cm of standing water. Refill the field.
why.noRain: No useful rain is expected in the next 2 days.
why.moist: The soil still has enough moisture. Check again in 2–3 days.
why.moistHot: The soil has moisture, but it will be hot (about {{temp}}°C). Check again tomorrow.
why.moistPaddy: Keep a thin layer of standing water; top up only if the field surface is showing.

irrigation.timing: Water early morning or evening so less is lost to the sun.
irrigation.noSpray: Do not spray pesticide or fertilizer before the rain; it will wash off.
irrigation.aiQuestion: My {{crop}} crop is at {{stage}} stage and the soil is {{soil}}. How much water should I give and how often?
irrigation.disclaimer: Advice uses the live rain forecast for your district and general rules. Your local agriculture officer knows your field best.

market.title: Market Prices
market.apiNote: A verified mandi API must provide price, unit, date and market.
market.noReports: No price reports for this market in the last 14 days. Try another market.

schemes.title: Government Schemes
schemes.contentNotice: Collected from official and news sources. Amounts and dates change — confirm at your Rythu Seva Kendra / Rythu Vedika or the official website before applying.

settings.title: Settings
settings.logoutBody: Your name, farm details and chats will be removed from this phone and the app will start again from the beginning. If you are using it without a verified phone number, this profile cannot be opened again.
settings.voiceSample: Namaskaram. I am your Annadata farming assistant.
settings.voiceHint: Tap a voice to hear it. Your phone’s voices are used; more can be added in Google speech settings.
settings.noVoices: No voices found for this language on this phone. Install it in Settings → Google text-to-speech.

verifyPhone.title: Verify your phone
verifyPhone.subtitle: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS. This keeps your farm details safe.

errors.aiBusy: The assistant is busy. Try again in a minute.
